purpose: Phase 1 source-size ratchet: warning above 300 physical lines, hard cap above 500. Legacy oversized application paths are frozen at the measured count in the 2026-11-13 main commit. Any growth above their prior count is blocked.
note: Physical lines include comments and blank lines. Exclusions are reported but not blocked. Architecture-specific rules in config/god-file-boundaries.json remain independent and may be stricter.
